# Shared stealth source references

Original byte-preserved reference slices are identified by complete repository,
commit, Git blob and SHA-256 in `docs/reviews/shared-stealth/sources.json`.
They retain their embedded author/source comments. They are not executable
dependency closures and are excluded from runtime distributions.

Engine adapters select AFT movement, awareness, contact/limb math and Fighters'
accepted-travel/carry binding. Native goat data, paint, rifle and Three are the
existing AFT 781246a snapshot; no second Three or new art asset is imported.
The existing `vendor/aft/781246a668c723d5a4c5463e70534cc04b6a5641/dist/tactics/vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt`
and project notices remain applicable.

No blanket license file was found in the reviewed donor roots. This source
inventory establishes provenance and adds no redistribution rights.
